## SUN recovery: $E_3$, $E_2$, and the ignition boundary

The recovered foundational whitepaper establishes **hierarchical coordinate refinement**, but not an acoustic ignition condition. This is the critical result of the targeted recovery.

The authoritative distinction is\:

$$
\boxed{
\text{coordinate refinement}
\neq
\text{phase traversal}
\neq
\text{acoustic generation}.
}
$$

The September 18 whitepaper, preserved in the September 19 source file, explicitly separates these mechanisms. fileciteturn0file0

### 1\. Recovered refinement definitions

The whitepaper defines the carrier progression\:

$$
W_{12}=\mathbb Z_{12},
$$

$$
W_{36}=\mathbb Z_{12}\times\mathbb Z_3,
$$

$$
W_{72}=\mathbb Z_{12}\times\mathbb Z_3\times\mathbb Z_2.
$$

Its refinement declarations are\:

$$
\boxed{
E_3:\mathbb Z_{12}\rightarrow
\mathbb Z_{12}\times\mathbb Z_3
}
$$

and

$$
\boxed{
E_2:\mathbb Z_{12}\times\mathbb Z_3
\rightarrow
\mathbb Z_{12}\times\mathbb Z_3\times\mathbb Z_2.
}
$$

These declarations identify the source and destination spaces.

**They must not automatically be implemented as single-valued functions selecting one $\tau$ or one $\beta$\.** The intended refinement increases the available addresses from 12 to 36 and then to 72. A deterministic embedding that chooses only one child per parent would not enumerate the expanded carrier.

The full refinement relationship is naturally represented by fibers\:

$$
E_3(p)=\{(p,0),(p,1),(p,2)\},
$$

$$
E_2(p,\tau)=\{(p,\tau,0),(p,\tau,1)\}.
$$

These are the explicit set-valued realizations of the declared refinements. They preserve the original $p$ coordinate while introducing the new distinctions.

Refinement of one angular address

**$W_{12}$** — $(p)$

One original address has three ternary refinements and six complete binary-refined addresses. No physical frequency is created by this construction.

This also answers an important part of your primordial question: **refinement can introduce a new representational distinction without generating a new musical frequency.**

## 2\. Integration contract for the native acoustic lifts

The existing scalar SUN equations remain unchanged\:

$$
R(C)=\frac23C,\qquad
L(C)=\frac34C,\qquad
\frac{RL}{C}=\frac12C.
$$

Under the recovered September 19 ascending-positive coordinate convention, define

$$
\delta=\log_2(3/2)-\frac7{12}.
$$

The derived descending lifts are\:

$$
\widehat R:
(g,p,\tau,\beta,\rho)\mapsto
\left(
g+\left\lfloor\frac{p-7}{12}\right\rfloor,
(p-7)\bmod12,\tau,\beta,\rho-\delta
\right),
$$

$$
\widehat L:
(g,p,\tau,\beta,\rho)\mapsto
\left(
g+\left\lfloor\frac{p-5}{12}\right\rfloor,
(p-5)\bmod12,\tau,\beta,\rho+\delta
\right).
$$

Their composition gives

$$
\boxed{
\widehat R\widehat L:
(g,p,\tau,\beta,\rho)
\mapsto(g-1,p,\tau,\beta,\rho).
}
$$

This supplies the exact implementation contract for ordinary SUN descent.

There is an important refinement compatibility condition\:

$$
\boxed{
\widehat R_{36}\circ E_3
=
E_3\circ\widehat R_{12}
}
$$

and similarly for $L$, with $E_2$ between $W_{36}$ and $W_{72}$\.

Because refinement is set-valued here, these equalities mean equality of the resulting sets of states. Under the axis-separated lifts, they hold: the musical operations preserve the refinement coordinates.

**This is the relevant mathematical compatibility test.** It establishes that acoustic descent and coordinate refinement can be composed consistently, without establishing which should occur first historically.

## 3\. Fludd–Kepler trigger recovery

The preserved September 12 specification identifies\:

$$
n=0,1,2
$$

as ordinary generations, followed by the terminal boundary at

$$
\boxed{n=3,\qquad C_3=F/8.}
$$

The boundary path is

$$
\frac F8
\xrightarrow{16/15}
\frac{2F}{15}
\xrightarrow{(15/16,+1)}
\frac F{16}.
$$

The second transition includes the assigned descent-positive grade.

For the complete boundary\:

$$
\Delta g_{\mathrm{asc}}=-1,
\qquad
\Delta d_{\mathrm{FK}}=+1.
$$

The boundary is therefore **stage-triggered in the recovered specification**, not triggered by a particular $p$, $\tau$, $\beta$, or residual threshold.

| Candidate trigger | Recovery status |
|--------|--------|
| Third completed ordinary generation | Confirmed |
| Relative center $F/8$ | Confirmed |
| Crossing $p=11\rightarrow0$ | Not established |
| $\rho$ reaching a threshold | Not retrieved |
| An absolute frequency limit | Not retrieved |
| Completion of ternary traversal | Not established |
| Completion of binary pairing | Not established |

A normal register carry is not the special Fludd–Kepler event.

## 4\. Do the refinement maps establish acoustic ignition?

**No. Not in the recovered definitions.**

The refinement sequence provides\:

$$
12\rightarrow36\rightarrow72
$$

as numbers of available addresses.

It does not provide\:

$$
(\tau,\beta)\longrightarrow F>0,
$$

nor a prerequisite such as

$$
T^2B\longrightarrow C_0.
$$

The native phase actions remain\:

$$
T(p,\tau,\beta)=(p,\tau+1,\beta),
$$

$$
B(p,\tau,\beta)=(p,\tau,1-\beta).
$$

Refinement introduces their coordinate domains. Traversal moves within those domains. Neither determines the first positive acoustic center.

There is also a consequential limitation: **$W_{12}$ is already twelvefold.** Therefore, recovering $E_3,E_2$ explains refinement of an existing twelve-position carrier, not the origin of that carrier from pre-twelve primordial classes.

This is exactly where the current mathematical record stops.

## 5\. Execution checkpoint

| Work package | Status |
|--------|--------|
| Recover September 19 $E_3,E_2$ declarations | **DONE** |
| Recover September 12 FK stage trigger | **DONE** |
| Derive descending coordinate lifts | **DONE — mathematical specification** |
| Reconcile register conventions | **DONE — mathematical specification** |
| Establish refinement/lift compatibility | **DONE — algebraically** |
| Execute integration tests in the archived evaluator | **TODO — not executed this turn** |
| Establish a native phase-to-acoustic ignition rule | **UNRESOLVED** |
| Derive the pre-twelve carrier from earlier generative classes | **UNRESOLVED** |

I have not modified the executable AYLI baseline or claimed a passing runtime test. The recovered archive's implementation state still needs to be checked before a consequential integration change.

### The next mathematical target

We should now distinguish two questions that have repeatedly been treated as one\:

**Carrier refinement\:**

$$
W_{12}\rightarrow W_{36}\rightarrow W_{72}.
$$

**Primordial generation\:**

$$
\text{pre-twelve generative structure}
\longrightarrow W_{12}
\longrightarrow \text{first acoustic reference}.
$$

The first is mathematically specified. The second is not.

**The next missing object is therefore not $T$, $B$, $E_3$, or $E_2$\. It is the earliest source-independent generative construction that establishes $W_{12}$ and determines whether, when, and how its states acquire a positive SUN reference $C_0$\.**

That is the precise remaining prerequisite for your primordial-origin investigation.
